question: Determine whether published maker/nonmaker wallet rows obey reversed-wallet construction or copied-wallet construction across the complete frozen published history.
scope: Read-only structural census of existing root and clean published rows, plus independent source/runtime/provenance diagnosis. This is not native collection completeness, economic-action certification, or a canon repair.

units.observation: Published wallet row at exact full-value multiplicity; not an independently identified execution.
units.correct_construction: Each maker row predicts a nonmaker row with flipped BUY/SELL, is_maker=false, proxyWallet=maker counterparty, and counterparty=maker proxyWallet.
units.copied_construction: Each maker row predicts a nonmaker row with flipped BUY/SELL and is_maker=false, retaining both maker wallet fields.
units.weight: Exact row multiplicity; no dollar-weighted or causal estimand.
units.uncertainty: Exhaustive frozen-artifact counts, not a statistical sample; no standard errors or significance tests.

outputs.primary: Exact maker-predicted versus observed nonmaker multiset differences under both constructions, by month and whole history.
outputs.compatibility: Common-class counts and nonmaker-row-weighted support classified correct-only, copied-only, both-compatible, or neither; preserve empty-role and ambiguous classes.
outputs.label_diagnostic: Repeat class comparison omitting eventSlug, separately labeled; never replaces full-field gates.
outputs.cleaning: Exact full eleven-field root DISTINCT versus clean multiset differences and root value-row surplus, reconciled within complete UTC-second leaves.
outputs.support: Row counts, role counts, gross recorded cash, leaf bounds, admission gates, input identities, runtime and peak RSS.

interpretation_rules: Class compatibility does not establish individual native pairing or historical writer membership.
Both-compatible classes can include self-wallet rows or collisions among distinct reciprocal maker wallet pairs.
Nonmaker excess relative to a construction is a structural incompatibility count, not identified erroneous wallets or economic volume.
Synthetic nonmaker opposite-side inference remains unverified economic action even if the published wallet fields are structurally consistent.
Do not infer sports-result impact without each report's separate input and flag lineage.

execution.host: Canonical EC2 checkout with verified mounted /mnt/data
execution.mode: Preflight then root-reviewed, expected-commit and approved-manifest-digest-bound body
execution.serialization: One production stage at a time; source-only and local fixture reviews may run independently.
execution.leaf_policy: Whole small UTC month when admitted; otherwise complete UTC days, recursively bisected at integer seconds as needed. No omitted leaves or second splitting.
execution.optimizer_note: Disable the projection-sharing pass that reproduces the frozen Stage6 wallet discrepancy; verify census outputs against independent Python multiset fixtures.
execution.output_policy: New immutable versioned stages; atomic publication, no overwrite, final input-identity reopen required.
execution.resource_note: DuckDB limit is not a hard process RSS guarantee; scalar-only summaries and observed RSS are recorded. Preflight estimates physical overlaps and full body plan before authorization.

prohibited: Modification of existing data, caches, pipeline writers or scientific estimates
Unreviewed storage expansion, scratch datasets or disk spill
Dropping collisions, irregular rows, inconvenient periods or unresolved classes
Replacing failed certification with wallet-pair compatibility
